description: Labeled boundary set for calibrating the verification gate's NLI + quote thresholds. Each case is a (chunk, claim, quote) triple with a ground-truth 'should_verify' label decided by MEANING, not by the current gate. Categories name the boundary each case probes. Run evals/calibrate.py (NLI enabled) to measure false-accept / false-reject rates at the shipped thresholds and to sweep them.
